meta.name: linkedin-engager-analytics
meta.description: Pull the people who liked or commented on any LinkedIn post and segment them by ICP fit (peer / aspirational / prospect / other). Produces an engager roster, tier breakdown, and outbound action lists (follow back, comment-drop, DM-able with one-line openers). Powered by Apify, no LinkedIn login. Triggers on "who liked my post", "who engaged", "engagers report", "audience analytics". Not for tracking author replies to your comments (use linkedin-thread-monitor).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 找出点赞评论过你帖子的联系人,按匹配度分层并生成跟进清单
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在 LinkedIn 发帖后想知道谁互动了、哪些值得主动跟进
copy.tagline_en: Turn post likers and commenters into ranked, follow-up-ready contact lists
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you post on LinkedIn and want to know who engaged and who's worth following up

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会抓取某条 LinkedIn 帖子的点赞者和评论者,按 ICP 匹配度分成同行、向往对象、潜在客户、其他四档,产出互动者名单和跟进动作清单(回关、评论、私信开场白)。依赖 APIFY_TOKEN,没有该令牌时改为由你粘贴名单。
howto.when: 当你提到「谁点赞了我的帖子」「谁参与了」「受众分析」等关键词,或要求分析某条帖子的互动者、按公司规模给他们分组时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析这条 LinkedIn 帖子的互动者,按 ICP 分档
say.note: 抓取点赞和评论者并输出分档名单

say.text: 把这几条帖子的互动者去重,标出参与了 2 条以上的人
say.note: 标记跨帖互动的高意向人群

say.text: 给潜在客户档的互动者各写一句私信开场白
say.note: 结合他们互动的那条帖子生成开场白

howto.what_en: Claude pulls likers and commenters from a LinkedIn post, buckets them by ICP fit (peer / aspirational / prospect / other), and outputs a roster plus action lists (follow back, comment, DM openers). Needs APIFY_TOKEN.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask who liked or engaged with a post, request an engagers report, or run audience analytics on a post URL.

say_en.text: Analyze the engagers on this LinkedIn post and bucket them by ICP tier
say_en.note: Pulls likers and commenters, outputs a tiered roster

say_en.text: Dedupe engagers across these posts and flag those who engaged 2+ times
Write a one-line DM opener for each prospect-tier engager
say_en.note: Uses the post they engaged with
